01
Connect

Write documents, upload files or connect an app. Each lands in a namespace.

02
Sync

A changed record replaces its old version. A deleted one is deleted.

03
Retrieve

Keyword and vector search find candidates. The reranker puts the best first.

04
Deliver

Your model gets the passages that answer the question, with their source.
